_doc: Read by scripts/check_intake_rates.py. expected_stale: courts whose zero intake is BY DESIGN (abolished court, frozen archive, no new volumes); they are reported EXPECTED and never fail the run. A coverage note is NOT an exemption: ow_gerichte and be_steuerrekurs are noted outages that are re-probed weekly and must keep surfacing until the probe yields rows. lag_days: series whose decision dates trail publication by months; the pro-rating window is shifted by that many days and the court is WAIT (not judged) while the remaining window is under 30 days. NOT exempted on purpose: vd_findinfo (its note calls it a frozen pre-2015 archive, but it received 2,444 rows dated 2025 and 0 dated 2026 — a feed death to look at, not a design).

ch_vb.reason: frozen archive; VPB/JAAC ceased publishing in 2016, preserved via the entscheidsuche archive

mkg.reason: Militaerkassationsgericht archival corpus, volumes 1-16 (1915-2025); the court publishes no new volumes

zh_kassationsgericht.reason: court abolished with the federal ZPO; last decisions 2012

emark.reason: EMARK series ended when the Asylrekurskommission was replaced by the BVGer in 2007

zh_gerichte.reason: umbrella code holding only the frozen March-2026 entscheidsuche mirror rows; the direct zh_gerichte scraper files rows under the sub-court codes

ag_gerichte.reason: umbrella code holding only the frozen entscheidsuche mirror rows; the direct ag_gerichte scraper files rows under the sub-court codes

vd_omni.reason: entscheidsuche mirror shard superseded by the direct vd_gerichte scraper (at parity since 2026-09)

sh_obergericht.reason: redundant entscheidsuche feed; the direct sh_gerichte scraper is at parity (retirement per the 2026-04-29 procedure pending)

tg_obergericht.reason: redundant entscheidsuche feed; the direct tg_gerichte scraper is at parity (retirement pending)

bge.evidence: 2026-09-09: volume 152 (2026) holds 104 decisions in the corpus, only 28 of them DATED 2026; the official collection publishes 6-12 months after the judgment, so the decision-year count is not judgeable before Q4. bge stays covered by the our_count stall detector in check_scraper_freshness.py.
